locator: Notes to consolidated financial statements - revenue by end market

weight.basis: NVIDIA FY2026 (ended 25 Jan 2026) 10-K: Data Center revenue $193,737m / total revenue $215,938m = 0.8972

notes: Data Center end-market revenue is mapped to the ai-servers node (its buyers are cloud providers, enterprises and server makers); Data Center includes networking ($31,376m) as well as compute ($162,361m), so the accelerator-only share is lower.
